from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EpSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Earnings per Share data extracted from a single financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in this financial filing")
    eps_value: float | None = Field(description="Earnings per share value; losses should be negative")
    eps_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label used for EPS (e.g. 'Net loss per share')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_records: list[EpSRecord]
